# 1\. Executive Summary

This document defines Module 07 - Role-Based Dashboard for the AMR Coordinator Portal (iPOMS). It consolidates the complete business documentation covering the dashboard's philosophy, the three role-based dashboard types, the Assigned Work feature, and the Metadata Merge Engine into a single functional specification.

The Role-Based Dashboard is the Home Screen, Landing Page, and Operational Command Center of iPOMS - the first screen displayed immediately after a successful login. It is an intelligent navigation center, not a data-entry screen: its purpose is to inform and guide, while all operational work continues to happen inside the Daily Tracker, Weekly Tracker, Daily Leads, and Reports & Analytics.

# 2\. Purpose

The dashboard exists to answer three questions within a few seconds of login:

- What is my priority today?
- What requires my immediate attention?
- Where should I go next?

It is not designed for users to perform operational work from; it summarizes what matters and routes the user to the correct module.

# 3\. Dashboard Philosophy

The dashboard follows one simple philosophy: inform the user, guide the user, never make the user work from the dashboard.

All operational work is completed inside dedicated modules:

- Daily Tracker
- Weekly Tracker
- Daily Leads
- Reports & Analytics

The dashboard only summarizes important information and provides direct navigation to where the work actually happens.

# 4\. Dashboard Workflow & Navigation

On login, the system authenticates the user, detects their role, and opens the corresponding Role-Based Dashboard: Login → Role Detection → Role-Based Dashboard.

From the dashboard, users can navigate to:

- Daily Tracker
- Weekly Tracker
- Daily Leads
- Reports
- Notifications
- Settings

Navigation is bidirectional - users move freely between the dashboard and every module without losing context, for example Dashboard → Daily Tracker → Weekly Tracker → Reports → Dashboard.

# 5\. Types of Dashboards

Three dashboards are available, one per role.

## 5.1 Placement Coordinator Dashboard

Purpose: daily operational management.

Primary Question: "What should I do today?"

## 5.2 Team Leader Dashboard

Purpose: monitor and guide coordinators.

Primary Question: "How is my team performing today?"

Additional capabilities:

- Assign work directly to coordinators.
- View coordinator performance.
- Monitor assignment completion.
- View acknowledgements.
- Track overall progress.

## 5.3 Administrator Dashboard

Purpose: organization-wide monitoring and management.

Primary Question: "How is the complete placement operation progressing?"

Permissions:

- Organization KPIs
- User Management
- Settings
- Broadcast announcements
- Notifications
- Reports
- View coordinator performance

The Administrator does not perform coordinator operational work.

# 6\. Dashboard Characteristics

Four rules govern the dashboard's behaviour.

## 6.1 Rule 1 - Interactive

Cards, widgets, buttons, and quick navigation all respond to user interaction.

## 6.2 Rule 2 - Non-Editable

Operational data cannot be edited from the dashboard; it is view mode only.

## 6.3 Rule 3 - Live

No manual refresh - every widget automatically reflects the latest data from Daily Tracker, Weekly Tracker, Daily Leads, Reports, Assigned Work, and Notifications.

## 6.4 Rule 4 - Minimal

Avoid clutter, unnecessary graphics, and excessive animations; maintain sufficient white space and a professional appearance. High-priority information always appears first.

# 7\. Dashboard Layout - Section Order

The final layout, top to bottom, is:

- Greeting
- Notifications
- Assigned Work
- Priority College
- Today's Tasks
- Today's KPI Summary
- Quick Navigation
- Insights

## 7.1 Greeting Section

The greeting changes automatically according to system time and uses the logged-in user's name:

- Morning - "Good Morning, \[Name\] 👋"
- Afternoon - "Good Afternoon, \[Name\] ☀️"
- Evening - "Good Evening, \[Name\] 🌇"
- After 8 PM - "Burning the midnight oil? Thanks for your dedication, \[Name\] 🌙"

## 7.2 Notifications Widget

Appears immediately below the greeting. Possible senders: CEO, Director, Team Leader, System - for example "Please prioritize XYZ College this week" (CEO), "Follow up with TCS today" (Team Leader), or "Weekly Report submission is due today" (System).

## 7.3 Assigned Work Widget

Detailed in Sections 8-10.

## 7.4 Priority College Widget

Each coordinator usually manages multiple colleges; one is marked priority. The widget shows Priority College, Today's Calls, Pending Follow-ups, and Status.

## 7.5 Today's Tasks

A maximum of three tasks, for example "Follow up with Infosys," "Share student database," or "Generate Weekly Report (Friday)" - never a long task list.

## 7.6 KPI Summary

Calls Assigned, Calls Completed, Pending Calls, Positive Responses, JD Received - a compact view only.

## 7.7 Quick Navigation

One-click shortcut cards to Daily Tracker, Weekly Tracker, Daily Leads, Reports, and Settings.

## 7.8 Insights Widget

Short operational insights, for example "Follow-up workload increased today," "Student database pending for two companies," or "Weekly report due today."

# 8\. Assigned Work - Signature Feature

Assigned Work became the signature feature of Module 07. It allows Team Leaders to assign operational work directly to coordinators. Assigned Work is not a chat system - it is an operational task assignment mechanism.

# 9\. Assigned Work Workflow & Card

Workflow: Team Leader Dashboard → Create Assignment → Select Coordinator → Select College → Enter Details → Send → Coordinator Dashboard → Assigned Work Widget.

Example card:

- Assigned Work - Priority: High
- College: ABC Engineering College
- Task: "Call these five companies before 11 AM."
- Actions: Load to Metadata, Mark Completed, View Details

Action buttons:

- Load to Metadata - loads the assigned company contact into the Metadata Database and performs an intelligent merge (Section 12).
- Mark Completed - marks the assignment complete and immediately removes it from the dashboard.
- View Details - displays the complete assignment information.

# 10\. Assignment Priority & Lifecycle

Assignments carry one of three priority levels - High, Medium, or Low - and the dashboard automatically sorts them by priority.

Lifecycle:

- Assigned
- Received
- Viewed
- Load to Metadata
- Mark Completed
- Hidden from Dashboard
- Automatically deleted from operational storage after 7 days

Completed assignments disappear immediately from the dashboard; operational storage automatically cleans itself after seven days.

# 11\. Dashboard Personalization

The dashboard is automatically personalized for every user, with no manual filtering or searching required. A coordinator only sees:

- Assigned Colleges
- Assigned Work
- Own KPIs
- Own Reports
- Own Notifications
- Own Follow-ups

Each coordinator sees only their own information.

# 12\. Metadata Merge Engine

Whenever a coordinator selects Load to Metadata, the system performs an intelligent merge. The Metadata Database remains the single source of truth.

| **Case** | **Condition**                                         | **Result**                                                                                |
| -------- | ----------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 1        | Company does not exist                                | Create an entirely new company (e.g. Infosys - Rahul - 9876543210 - <rahul@infosys.com>). |
| 2        | Company exists; HR, mobile, and email all different   | Add as another contact under the same company.                                            |
| 3        | Company and HR same; mobile different                 | Append the new mobile number (e.g. 9876543210 + 9988776655).                              |
| 4        | Company and HR same; email different                  | Append the new email address.                                                             |
| 5        | Company same; HR different; everything else different | Store as another HR contact under the same company.                                       |

# 13\. Metadata Audit Fields

Every contact stores Added By, Added Date, and Assigned By:

| **Company** | **HR** | **Mobile** | **Email**           | **Added By** | **Added Date** | **Assigned By** |
| ----------- | ------ | ---------- | ------------------- | ------------ | -------------- | --------------- |
| Infosys     | Rahul  | 9876543210 | <rahul@infosys.com> | Lokesh       | 23-Mar-2026    | Team Leader A   |

A separate Assigned Date field was discussed and intentionally omitted, to keep the design simple.

# 14\. Assigned Work Storage Strategy

Assigned Work is temporary - an operational inbox only, not permanent storage: Assignment → Load to Metadata → Completed → Hidden from Dashboard → Deleted after 7 Days.

Permanent storage remains only inside the Metadata Database.

# 15\. Metadata Database Philosophy

The Metadata Database is the single source of truth. Every valid contact eventually resides here; Assigned Work never becomes permanent storage.

Auto-merge logic: whenever a company already exists, the system checks HR, then Mobile, then Email, in that order, and only inserts new values - duplicate values are ignored automatically. For example, an existing record of Infosys / Rahul / 9876543210 merged with an incoming Infosys / Rahul / 9988776655 results in Infosys / Rahul / 9876543210 + 9988776655, with no duplicate numbers.

# 16\. UI Design Principles

- Minimal
- Professional
- Responsive
- White-space friendly
- Fast loading
- Interactive
- No unnecessary animations
- No clutter
- High-priority information first
- Responsive widgets
- Modern enterprise appearance

# 17\. Role-Based Permission Matrix

| **Feature / Action**                                 | **Coordinator** | **Team Leader** | **Administrator** |
| ---------------------------------------------------- | --------------- | --------------- | ----------------- |
| View own dashboard                                   | Y               | Y               | Y                 |
| View coordinator / team performance                  | N               | Y               | Y                 |
| Create and send Assigned Work                        | N               | Y               | N/A               |
| Receive, load to metadata, or complete Assigned Work | Y               | N/A             | N/A               |
| Broadcast announcements                              | N               | N               | Y                 |
| Manage users                                         | N               | N               | Y                 |
| Manage settings                                      | N               | N               | Y                 |
| View organization-wide KPIs                          | N               | N               | Y                 |

# 18\. Integration With Other Modules

- Authentication: supplies the confirmed identity that role detection uses to open the correct dashboard.
- Assigned Work: feeds into the Metadata Database via the Load to Metadata action.
- Metadata Database (Module 02): supplies contacts consumed elsewhere in iPOMS, including the Daily Tracker's read-only picker.
- Daily Tracker / Weekly Tracker: supply the live call and pipeline data shown in the dashboard's KPI and task widgets.
- Reports & Analytics (Module 06): supplies the figures shown in the KPI Summary and Insights widgets.
- Notifications: feeds the Notifications widget directly.

Everything remains synchronized automatically; the dashboard never stores its own copy of operational data.

# 19\. Business Rules Summary

- Three role-based dashboards exist: Placement Coordinator, Team Leader, and Administrator.
- The dashboard is informational, not operational - no operational data can be edited from it.
- The dashboard remains live at all times; there is no manual refresh control.
- The dashboard is personalized automatically; there is no manual filtering or searching.
- Team Leaders assign work directly to coordinators; Assigned Work appears as a dedicated dashboard widget.
- The Metadata Database is the single source of truth for company and HR contacts.
- An intelligent merge engine prevents duplicate company and contact records.
- Every metadata entry stores audit fields - Added By, Added Date, and Assigned By.
- Assigned Work is hidden from the dashboard immediately after it is marked complete.
- Operational Assigned Work records are automatically deleted after seven days; only the Metadata Database is permanent.
- The dashboard remains minimal, clean, and enterprise-focused, with high-priority information always shown first.

# 20\. Deferred / Out of Scope for v1.0

- A separate Assigned Date field (distinct from Added Date) - discussed and intentionally omitted to keep the design simple.
- Chat or messaging functionality - Assigned Work is explicitly an operational task assignment mechanism, not a chat system.
- User-customizable widget order or dashboard layout - the section order defined in Section 7 is fixed for v1.0.
- A manual refresh control - not required, since the dashboard is fully live (Section 6.3).

# 21\. Conclusion

Module 07 is considered functionally complete (Business Design Version 1.0). The Role-Based Dashboard gives every user - Coordinator, Team Leader, and Administrator - a live, personalized, single-glance view of what matters today, while keeping all operational editing inside its dedicated modules. The Assigned Work widget and Metadata Merge Engine turn the dashboard into a genuine operational command center rather than a passive summary screen.
